response.sql: WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM per_name) SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amount AS average_budgeted_amount, p.avg_amount - o.mean_avg AS amount_above_mean_of_averages, p.avg_amount / o.mean_avg AS ratio_to_mean_of_averages FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.mean_avg;

assumptions.assumption: Events are grouped by event_name, so events that share a name are pooled. Each name counts once in the mean of averages. Names whose amounts are all NULL have no average and are left out of that mean.
An inner join between budget and event drops budget lines with no matching event.
